payments.solana-mobile-card-fees-saved.definition: Estimated card fees Solana Mobile avoided on Chapter 2 preorders by taking Solana Pay through Helio's Shopify plugin (assumes a 3% card fee).

payments.boba-guys-passport-users.definition: Users who joined Boba Guys Passport, its Solana loyalty program, in the program's first 80 days.
payments.boba-guys-passport-users.note: Replaces an unsourced 23,000; the case study reports 15,000 sign-ups in the first 80 days.
